description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeService class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The class provides methods to purge employee and candidate data according to specified strategies, handling transactions, events, and dependencies related to data deletion in the HRM system.

classes.name: PurgeService
classes.description: Service class responsible for purging employee and candidate data based on configured strategies, with transaction management and event dispatching.

methods.name: getPurgeDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of PurgeDao, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeePictureService, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: purgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs a transaction to purge data related to a specific employee, dispatching relevant events.

methods.name: purgeCandidateData
methods.description: Performs a transaction to purge data related to a specific candidate vacancy.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Loads and returns the list of entities configured for purging from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Constructs and returns a purge strategy object based on the class name, strategy name, and configuration info.
